text: A bus route with one stop too many. The lantern is lit.
picture: The Storyteller stands beside a rain-slicked country road at night, holding a glowing red lantern aloft. Dark, empty fields stretch behind him into a mist-shrouded distance, the road vanishing into blackness.
motion: slow subtle movement: the figure breathes and shifts, chalk dust drifts

text: I drive the last bus on Route 14. Twelve stops, then the depot.
picture: Tomas is alone in the driver's seat of a night bus, his face lit by the greenish dashboard glow. His heavy eyes stare ahead through a windscreen streaked with rain, hands resting on the wheel. Dark, empty seats fill the frame behind him.
motion: slow subtle movement: the figure breathes and shifts, chalk dust drifts

text: Last Tuesday, someone rang the bell after stop twelve. There's nothing out there.
picture: A tight shot of a single glowing red STOP bell light on the bus ceiling. Beyond it, through the rain-beaded window, are featureless, moonlit fields. The red glow is the only bright colour in the frame.
motion: slow subtle movement: the figure breathes and shifts, chalk dust drifts

text: Just fields, and one dead streetlight.
picture: A reflection in the bus's convex interior mirror shows Tomas's tired eyes in the foreground. In the distant background, a woman in a dripping yellow raincoat sits perfectly still on the back seat, her hood a dark void.
motion: slow subtle movement: the figure breathes and shifts, chalk dust drifts

text: I checked the mirror. One passenger.
picture: The bus sits stopped under a flickering, solitary streetlight in a vast, empty field. The front doors are open, revealing the dark interior. No one is visible inside or outside.

text: A woman in a wet yellow raincoat, hood up, on the back seat. I never saw her get on.
picture: From outside the bus, looking in through the open doors. Tomas is a silhouette in the driver's seat, looking back. On the very back seat, barely visible in the deep shadows, sits the pale shape of a person in a yellow raincoat.

text: I turned around. The back seat was empty.
picture: A damp, worn bus seat fills the frame, the fabric dark and stained. On the patterned floor beneath it lies a single puddle of inky black water, reflecting a dim aisle light ceiling above.

text: Just a puddle, and the smell of river water.
picture: An extreme close-up on the dark puddle on the bus floor, its surface distorted and rippling faintly as if disturbed. The reflection of a dim red light from somewhere off-frame shimmers in its oily depths.

text: I faced the road again, and the camera screen above my head showed her.
picture: A grainy, fish-eye security camera view looks down from the front of the bus. At the wheel, Tomas grips it tightly, his jaw set in strained tension. The glowing red STOP bell light casts a bloody smear across his jacket. In the aisle doorway behind his seat, a stark silhouette of The Woman in Yellow is framed, her hooded head turned toward the camera.

sound: the low hum of a bus engine

picture: The grainy CCTV view zooms on the driver's seat. Tomas's shoulder and neck muscles are taut, his expression frozen in a sidelong glance of dread. Just behind his headrest, filling one side of the frame, are the pale, wet fingers of The Woman in Yellow, resting on the fabric. The red STOP light bleeds into the shot's corner.

text: Route 14 still runs every night. If the bell rings after the last stop, keep driving.
picture: The Storyteller, a weary man holding a red lantern, stands in the middle of a dark, misty road. He looks over his shoulder with an expression of grim caution. Behind him, blurred by pouring rain and distance, the taillights of a bus glow and recede into the black hollow of trees.
